name: deploy
description: Deploy the application to a target environment (staging or production). Runs pre-deploy checks (tests, lint, build), deploys, and runs post-deploy health checks.

inputs.name: skipTests
inputs.description: If true, skip pre-deploy tests. Default: false (not recommended).

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Deployment result: environment, version, url, status, durationMs, healthCheckPassed.

failureConditions.signal: test suite exit code is non-zero
environment=production and no staging deploy in history
